title: Scalable Deep Unfolding of Conic Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2606.13825v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep unfolding (DU) accelerates iterative optimizers by training learnable components through unrolled iterations, but extending DU to the large-scale semidefinite programs (SDPs) common in robotics has remained limited. Unrolling a full-update conic solver such as COSMO exposes two obstacles: backpropagating through the per-iteration linear-system solve incurs memory quadratic in the problem size when the coefficient matrix is formed explicitly, and backpropagating through the positive semidefinite (PSD) cone projection is numerically unstable under repeated eigenvalues. We address the first with a matrix-free implicit differentiation rule that reduces memory from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n + \mathrm{nnz}(A))$, and the second with a stable backward rule based on the Dale\v{c}kii--Krein representation of the Fr\'echet derivative. Together, these enable learning lightweight hyperparameter policies and warm starts for COSMO. On standalone

translated_title: 可扩展的锥优化器深度展开
translated_abstract: 深度展开（DU）通过在展开的迭代过程中训练可学习组件来加速迭代优化器，但将DU扩展到机器人学中常见的大规模半定规划（SDP）方面的研究一直有限。对COSMO等全更新锥求解器进行展开会遇到两个障碍：其一，当显式构造系数矩阵时，通过每次迭代的线性系统求解进行反向传播会导致内存随问题规模呈二次方增长；其二，在存在重复特征值的情况下，通过半正定（PSD）锥投影进行反向传播在数值上不稳定。我们通过无矩阵的隐式微分规则解决了第一个问题，将内存消耗从 $O(n^2)$ 降低到 $O(n + \mathrm{nnz}(A))$；并通过基于Fréchet导数的Daleckii–Krein表示的稳定反向传播规则解决了第二个问题。这两项技术相结合，使得能够为COSMO学习轻量级的超参数策略和热启动策略。
tldr: 该论文提出了无矩阵隐式微分规则与基于Daleckii–Krein表示的稳定反向传播规则，将深度展开应用于锥求解器COSMO时的内存消耗从O(n²)降至O(n + nnz(A))，并解决了PSD锥投影反向传播的数值不稳定性，从而实现了对大规模半定规划的可扩展深度展开。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a matrix-free implicit differentiation rule and a numerically stable backward rule based on the Daleckii–Krein representation, reducing memory from O(n²) to O(n + nnz(A)) and stabilizing backpropagation through PSD cone projections, thereby enabling scalable deep unfolding of the conic solver COSMO for large-scale semidefinite programs.
